# Real repository examples

The prose and code samples below are not broken repository paths:

- `console.log`, `it.skip`, and `nodes.value.push` are dotted identifiers.
- `excalidraw.com`, `3.11`, and `0.2.1` are not file paths.
- `@AGENTS.md` imports this file and is present beside it.
- `operators/` and `rule-editor/alert-rule-form/` name external or scoped concepts.
- `./target/debug/deno` and `tmp/test-output.log` are generated output examples.
- `path/to/file.ts`, `vYYYY_MM_DD.py`, and `*.test.tsx` are placeholders or globs.
- `vercel/next.js` is a GitHub owner/repository slug.
- `N8N_BASE_URL/api/v1/` is a configuration URL path.
